changelog:
## [2.2.0]

### Added
- Rebranded application from NearDrop to **QuckDrop**
- Premium SwiftUI About View window in AirDrop style
- Full 18 macOS languages localization support
- Safe terminate prevention (windows close to status bar tray)
- Contacts avatars & names integration
- Trusted devices (Auto-Accept whitelist)
- Context menu options to add/remove trusted devices
- Share Extension and Finder services support
